scope: Independent read-only review; no game or browser suites executed, no repository or remote changes.

sourceProof.execution: Read-only string reconstruction and byte/hash comparisons, not game/test execution.

findings.observation: At viewport widths <=360 CSS px, the final same-specificity letter-spacing is .04em. Above360 the accepted .12em remains. No later rule changes it; brand stays Cinzel700/1rem, sigil30px, inner gap9px, title gap8px, Settings44x44px. The battle-only uppercase declaration is retained.
findings.limit: The brand still has flex:1/min-width:0 and a single unbroken word. Static cascade review cannot prove actual glyph clearance with loaded fonts; original per-glyph/gear browser measurement must decide. Header height remains44px.

findings.observation: The scoped flex-wrap and intrinsic identity minimum win over the original min-width:0. Portrait remains58px, identity name16px, class.6rem with.065em tracking, action font.6875rem and min48x48px. An action may wrap to the next flex line when required; DOM order and all actual handlers remain identical. Locked/unrecruited cards use the same scoped identity rule without a toggle.
findings.limit: Actual font-dependent line breaking and all eight class/role glyph boundaries require browser proof. No CSS order property, clipping, hidden text or font reduction was introduced.

findings.observation: Unitless1.4 is not overridden later. At root16 toast text.76rem is12.16px with17.024px line-height; at root32 it is24.32px with34.048px line-height, replacing the old fixed16px. Native text, pointer behavior, role/aria, 2200ms timeout and last-chosen refusal handler are unchanged.
findings.limit: This is computed CSS arithmetic, not measured glyph spacing or browser acceptance; immediate/settled adjacent line rectangles still need actual checks.
